steps.title: Auth & Config — GET new_request_config
steps.plain: Sign in with the account's token and read its event settings: how long an RFP runs, how it is evaluated and closed, and which terms and conditions exist.
steps.expected: The token is accepted (200), the run's settings are valid, and the account has duration presets for RFP events.
steps.actual: Signed in. RFQ events here run 30 min by default with a 30 min evaluation window, closing "line_item_based".

checks.name: The account has duration presets for RFQ events
The default duration is one of the allowed durations
The default evaluation window is one of the allowed windows
The default closing mode is a known value
The default RFP evaluation mode is a known value
Terms and conditions have unique ids

cases.title: GET new_request_config WITHOUT token → 401
cases.plain: Try to read the account's event settings without signing in.
cases.expected: The app refuses it with 401 or 403 and says why — no server error.

steps.title: Search Products — GET products/search
steps.plain: Search the catalogue and pick the products the event will source, with a unit, a variant and a quantity for each.
steps.expected: The search returns products, and enough of them are active and approved to make the line items asked for.
steps.actual: Found 20 products for "a" and picked 2: About Hit × 5 Set; Accept Memory × 10 Pack.

checks.name: The search returned at least one product
Every product has a unit and a variant
Enough eligible products for 2 line items
Unit and variant overrides fit the chosen products
Every quantity is a positive number

cases.title: Product search SQL injection payload → no 5xx, no leak
cases.plain: Search products for ' OR 1=1-- and make sure no database error leaks out.
cases.expected: No server error, and no SQL error text in the reply.

cases.title: Product search XSS payload → no 5xx, not reflected raw
cases.plain: Search products for a <script> tag and make sure it is not echoed back unescaped.
cases.expected: No server error, and the script tag is not reflected as-is.
cases.actual: Refused with 403: <!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>403</title>403 Forbidden

checks.name: The script tag is not reflected unescaped

calls.responseText: <!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>403</title>403 Forbidden

notes: Behaviour: HTTP 403 — <!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>403</title>403 Forbidden

cases.title: Product search empty query → no 5xx

cases.expected: No server error. Whatever the app does with it is recorded.

cases.title: Product search no match → empty products
cases.plain: Search products for text nothing contains.
cases.expected: No server error. Whatever the app does with it is recorded.

cases.title: 10 parallel product searches
cases.plain: Search the catalogue 10 times at once with the run's own search.
cases.expected: All 10 come back 200, each within the limit, with the same products.
cases.actual: 10 at once: 10 returned 200; fastest 1196 ms, average 1984 ms, p95 3028 ms, slowest 3028 ms.

checks.name: Status code is 200 for all 10 searches
Responds within 8000 ms — every one of the 10 at once
p95 of the parallel calls is under 8000 ms

cases.title: RFP invalid evaluator / RFQ invalid delivery location → 4xx
cases.plain: Add a stage with an evaluator who does not exist (RFP), or a delivery location that does not exist (RFQ).
cases.expected: The app refuses it with a 4xx and says why — no server error.
cases.actual: Refused with 422: {"error":{"code":483,"message":"You are not authorized to add delivery location"}}
